thread:
sam-sales: Heads up — FinCorp wants a BYO‑HSM integration for Private deployment with cross-region key replication. They asked for: dual‑custodian key ceremony, monthly rotation window 00:00–02:00 UTC, 13 months audit log retention, and FIPS Level 3 attestation. Need preflight checklist, rough cost delta, and what evidence we can provide for their auditors. @maria-crypto @liam-solutions @anita-billing

maria-crypto: Quick clarifying Qs — are they expecting to run inference on Dedicated GPU pools or fully Private (on‑prem) nodes? throughput target (rps / tokens per month)? Also which HSM vendors are allowed on their side?

sam-sales: They said Private (customer VPC + on‑prem model servers). Throughput: ~200 qps peak, ~1.5B tokens / month. HSM vendor: customer prefers Thales but open to CloudHSM if we can meet attestation.

liam-solutions: Ok — listing core preflight items for ops:
- Network: VPC peering + static routes, IP allowlist, egress TLS only (443).
- Ports: 443 for API, 22 only for scheduled ops (jumpbox).
- Certificates: exchange CA chain + client cert for mutual TLS to HSM proxy.
- HSM handshake: vendor certs, attestation report, firmware versions.
- Key management: envelope encryption recommended (service KEK in HSM, DEKs on instances).
- Audit: syslog/ELK export + signed key ceremony logs (immutable).

Also sample KMS policy we typically give customers (redacted):
```json
{
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodOps"}, "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"], "Resource": "*"}
  ]
}
```

kevin-security: For the auditors we can provide: HSM vendor FIPS/CC attestation PDFs, signed key ceremony transcripts (time + participants), CloudHSM/Thales HSM module serials, and our KMS access logs with integrity proofs. Note: we do NOT allow export of HSM private keys from customer HSMs — envelope encryption only. Also confirm whether they need split‑custodian for key activation (we support 2‑of‑3 via our custody workflow).

anita-billing: Cost heads up: BYO‑HSM onboarding one‑time engineering setup estimate = $30k–$50k (network + runbook + attestation review). Ongoing: +$8k/mo integration & audit retention + metered inference costs. If they require reserved Dedicated capacity to hit 200 qps peak with SLOs, add ~$12k/mo reserved. These are placeholders until we get exact token/month and retention/SLAs.

sam-sales: Customer replies (paste): "We need SAML SSO for ops access, 13mo audit retention, and formal attestation for FIPS Level 3. We also need an estimate for the dual‑custodian ceremony support (onsite vs remote)."

maria-crypto: For ceremony options:
- Remote: we support remote electronic signing + recorded video + signed transcript (no extra fee, standard).
- Onsite: requires travel + on‑prem engineer time, estimate $8k–$16k depending on location and duration. Recommend starting remote, escalate to onsite only if customer policy demands physical presence.

kevin-security: Also confirm SAML IdP metadata (entity ID, ACS URL) and SCIM provisioning if they want centrally managed operator accounts. We can map SAML groups to internal roles; we keep a proof of mapping for audit.

liam-solutions: Quick runbook snippet for customers to run when handing off keys (example CLI):
```bash
# create external CMK binding
rwin key create --name fincorp-cmk --backend external --hsm-vendor thales --mode envelope --rotation monthly
# export metadata
rwin key export-meta --key fincorp-cmk > fincorp-key-meta.json
```

deploy-bot: Deployment note: BYO‑HSM preflight checklist ticket #SF-2387 created and assigned to eng‑infra.

anita-billing: FYI I updated provisional quote in DealDB (estimate attached). Sam — please push final tokens/month and confirm whether they want reserved capacity. That will lock monthly pricing.

sam-sales: Will do — I'll reply to FinCorp asking for final token estimate, IdP metadata, and preferred ceremony mode. Thanks everyone, will update thread when they respond. :thumbsup:
